sanskrit: karkī subhāga ṛṣabhasya patnī prajākāmā vaśinī vāśitā gauḥ | tāṃ sahasram ekamukhā dadāti garbhaṃ dadhānām ṛtunā carantīm ||
english: The karkī cow, blessed and fortunate, wife of the bull, desirous of offspring, obedient, lowing — she who is in-calf and moves in season: a single donor gives her as one among a thousand.

sanskrit: garbhaṃ dadhānā paya id duhānā agnihotraṃ vaiśvadevī duhānā | gaur ṇo mā hiṃsīd varuṇasya patnī ||
english: She who bears the embryo and yields milk, she who, as the cow of all the gods (vaiśvadevī), is milked for the agnihotra — may that cow not harm us; she is the spouse of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: karkyā yoniṃ saṃmanaso 'bhi gāvaḥ prajāṃ dhitsanto vṛṣaṇaś caranti | sā na aitv aditir viśvarūpā- -abhi krandanti bhuvanāny enām ||
english: Toward the womb of the karkī cow the bulls move in one accord, eager to beget offspring. May she come to us as Aditi of all forms; the worlds cry out to her.

sanskrit: prajāpatineṣitām ṛtviyāvatīm aināṃ prajāyā ṛṣabhāḥ śrayante | vṛṣaṇyantīṃ vṛṣaṇaḥ saptanāmnīṃ hiṃkṛṇvanto abhi nudantu vāśitām ||
english: Sent forth by Prajāpati, full of seasonable vigor, the bulls resort to her for offspring. Let the virile bulls, bellowing, press upon her as she lows in desire — the seven-named lowing cow.

sanskrit: sā praty adarśy uṣasā suvarṇā śukrāṃ vasānā varuṇasya nirṇijam | vaiśvadevī svadhām ābharantī prajāṃ dātā puṣyatu gopatiṣ ṭe ||
english: She was seen facing the dawn, golden in hue, clothed in the bright garment of Varuṇa, bringing the oblation as the cow of all gods — may the lord of cattle prosper the offspring for your giver.

sanskrit: svayaṃsthāvary ṛṣabhāya tiṣṭhasi pratīcī somaṃ prati sūryam agnim | ahiṃsantī vāśite mām upehi paśūn dātā puṣyatu gopatiṣ ṭe ||
english: Self-standing, O lowing cow, you stand firm for the bull, facing Soma, Sūrya, and Agni. Come to me without harm, O lowing one; may the lord of cattle prosper the livestock for your giver.

sanskrit: vaśī dātā bhavatu vāśitāyā agner bhāgam usriyāṃ yo dadāti | priyaṃ dhāma hṛdayaṃ somyaṃ madhu vājinīṃ tvā vājino vājayantu ||
english: Prosperous shall the giver be — he who gives the radiant cow as Agni's share; the winning steeds shall stimulate you, O prize-bearing one, in your dear abode, the heart, sweet with Soma.

sanskrit: yo vāśitāyāṃ gavy antar agnir yad asyāṃ nṛmṇaṃ mahimā babhūva | namas tasmai pratigṛhṇan kṛṇomi syonā me astu tanve suśevā ||
english: I render homage while receiving her — to that fire which dwells within the lowing cow, and to the manly greatness and might that has arisen in her. May she be pleasant and gracious to my person.

sanskrit: eyam agan vāśitā tāṃ pratīmaḥ puṃsāṃ vrātena saha puṣṭyā gauḥ | ūrjaṃ dadhānā ghṛtam id duhānā sahasrapoṣāya me astu dātre ||
english: The lowing cow has come; we receive her — the cow of nourishment together with the troop of males. Bearing strength and yielding ghee, may she bring thousandfold prosperity for my giver.

sanskrit: anāptā ye vaḥ prathamā yāni karmāṇi cakrire | vīrān no atra mā dabhan tad va etat puro dadhe ||
english: Those first deeds which you performed without being reached — let them not harm our heroes here. That which is yours I place before you.

sanskrit: pratnān mānāt pari ye saṃbabhūvuḥ ślokavantaḥ saumanasasya vantavaḥ | apānakṣāso badhirā ahāsata- -ṛtasya panthāṃ na taranti duṣkṛtaḥ ||
english: Those who were born beyond the ancient measure, possessed of renown, partakers of benevolence — the eyeless, the deaf have stumbled and laughed; the wicked do not cross the path of ṛta.

sanskrit: sahasradhāram abhi te sam asvaran divo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ | tasya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ padepade pāśinaḥ santu setave ||
english: Toward the thousand-streamed one, the honey-tongued, the unwearied ones sang out together at the vault of heaven. His spies, the vigilant, never close their eyes; at every step let the snare-layers stand as a barrier.

sanskrit: pary ū ṣu pra dhanvā vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ | divas tad arṇavām̐ anv īyase sanisraso nāmāsi trayodaśo māsaḥ ||
english: Indeed, run forward all around for the winning of prizes; conquer on all sides the obstacles. You follow that ocean of the sky in its flow — you are called Sanisras, the thirteenth month.

sanskrit: indrasya gṛho 'sīndrasya śarmāsīndrasya varmāsīndrasya varūtham asi | vy etenāvaitenāpaitenārātsīr asau svāhā ||
english: You are Indra's house, you are Indra's shelter, you are Indra's armor, you are Indra's protection. Drive away with this, ward off with this, send away with this that adversary yonder — svāhā!

sanskrit: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevāv agnīṣomāv iha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ | mumuktam asmān gṛbhītān avadyāj juṣethāṃ yajñam amṛtam asmāsu dhattaṃ svāhā ||
english: O Agni and Soma, of sharp weapons, of sharp missiles, most gracious — be kind to us here. Release us, who are seized, from blame; take pleasure in the sacrifice; bestow immortality upon us — svāhā!

sanskrit: cakṣuṣo hete manaso hete brahmaṇo hete menyāmenir asi | amenayas te santu ye 'smān abhyaghāyanti svāhā ||
english: You are the snare of the eye, the snare of the mind, the snare of brahman; you are anger-upon-anger. Let those who seek to injure us be without anger toward us — svāhā!

sanskrit: yo 'smāñ cakṣuṣā manasā yaś ca vācākūtyā cittyā brahmaṇāghāyur abhidāsāt | tam agne tvaṃ menyāmeniṃ kṛṇu svāhā ||
english: Whoever has assailed us with harmful intent — by eye, by mind, by speech, by design, by thought, by brahman-power — him, O Agni, turn into anger-upon-anger — svāhā!

sanskrit: ud āyur ut kṛtam ud balam un manīṣod indriyaṃ nṛmṇam asmāsu dhehi svāhā ||
english: Raise up life-force, raise up glory, raise up strength; raise up mental power, vital force, and manly might — bestow these upon us — svāhā!

sanskrit: āyuṣkṛtāyuṣmatī svadhāvantau gopā me stho gopāyataṃ mā | ātmasadau me staṃ tanve suśevau mā mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ svāhā ||
english: You two are makers of life, you are full of life-force, possessed of svadhā; be my guardians, protect me. Abide in my self, be gracious to my person, do not harm me — svāhā!

sanskrit: indrasya gṛho 'sīndrasya śarmāsīndrasya varmāsīndrasya varūtham asi | taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvāṅgaḥ sarvātmā sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ saha yan me 'sti tena ||
english: You are Indra's house, you are Indra's shelter, you are Indra's armor, you are Indra's protection. Into you I enter — whole in every limb, whole in my entire self, completely uttered, fully a person — together with all that is mine.

sanskrit: astṛto nāmāham ayam asmi sa ātmānaṃ pari dadhe dyāvāpṛthivībhyām | gopīthāya pra hūyase ||
english: I am he whose name is 'the Unscattered'; I surrender my self to Heaven and Earth. You are invoked for protection.

sanskrit: astṛto nāma prājāpatyo devo māsas trayodaśaḥ | sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ prāgāṃ devapurā aham ||
english: The divine thirteenth month, offspring of Prajāpati, bears the name 'the Unscattered.' Completely utterred, fully a person — I have gone forward to the divine citadels.

sanskrit: antaḥ prāgāṃ devapurāḥ sahagrāmaḥ svastaye | saṃvatsarasya madhyataḥ sarvaiḥ sodaryaiḥ saha ||
english: I have gone into the divine citadels — together with the community, for well-being — from the middle of the year, together with all my brothers.

sanskrit: prāham agāṃ devapurā ya evāsmi sa eva san | yo mā kaś cābhidāsati sa prajāpatim ṛcchatu ||
english: I have gone forward to the divine citadels, being exactly who I am. Whoever assails me, let him reach Prajāpati.

sanskrit: aśmāsi pratispaśaḥ pāhi riṣaḥ pāhi dviṣaḥ | pāhi daivyābhiśastyāḥ sa ma iha tanvaṃ pāhi ||
english: You are stone, a watchful sentinel — guard me from injury, guard me from enmity. Guard me from divine imprecation; guard my person here.

sanskrit: yo 'smān prācyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt | etat sa ṛcchād aśmavarma no 'stu ||
english: Whoever has assailed us with harmful intent from the eastern quarter — let him meet this; may our armor of stone stand firm.

sanskrit: (…) asmān dakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ (…) ||
english: [Lacunose: parallel verse for the southern quarter — as above, 'Whoever has assailed us with harmful intent from the southern quarter — let him meet this; may our armor of stone stand firm.']

sanskrit: (…) asmān pratīcyā diśaḥ (…) ||
english: [Lacunose: parallel verse for the western quarter — as above, 'Whoever has assailed us with harmful intent from the western quarter — let him meet this; may our armor of stone stand firm.']
